scripts.text:
delete from stg.csi_Item ;

With itmst as
(
	SELECT  
		VariationNumber
		,row_number() over (partition by site_ref,item order by VariationNumber desc) rn
		,4 as 'SourceSystemID'
		,site_ref
		,item
		,description
		,abc_code
		,supply_site
		,supply_whse
		,prod_type
		,p_m_t_code
		,product_code
		,stat -- Active / Obsolete / Slowmoving
		,Uf_hierachy_level1
		,Uf_hierachy_level2
		,Uf_hierachy_level3
		,Uf_hierachy_level4
		,Uf_item_header
		,CAST(RecordDate as datetime) RecordDate
		,DLDeleteIndicator
	FROM raw.csi_item_mst
)
INSERT INTO stg.csi_Item
           (SourceSystemID
           ,site_ref
           ,item
           ,description
           ,abc_code
           ,supply_site
           ,supply_whse
           ,prod_type
           ,p_m_t_code
           ,product_code
           ,stat
           ,RecordDate
           ,DLDeleteIndicator
           ,Uf_hierachy_level1
           ,Uf_hierachy_level2
           ,Uf_hierachy_level3
           ,Uf_hierachy_level4
           ,Uf_item_header)

select 
	itmst.SourceSystemID
	,itmst.site_ref
	,itmst.item
	,itmst.description
	,itmst.abc_code
	,itmst.supply_site
	,itmst.supply_whse
	,itmst.prod_type
	,itmst.p_m_t_code
	,itmst.product_code
	,itmst.stat
	,itmst.RecordDate
	,itmst.DLDeleteIndicator
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level1
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level2
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level3
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level4
	,itmst.Uf_item_header
from itmst
where itmst.rn = 1;

delete from dbo.temp_DimItem ;

insert into temp_DimItem
(Site, Item, Description, ABC_Code, ProductType, PMT_Code, ProductCode, Stat, ItemHeader, ProductCategory, ProductSubCategory, ProductFamily, ProductName, RecordDate )
SELECT 
	site_ref
	,trim(item) item
	,description
	,abc_code
	,prod_type
	,p_m_t_code
	,product_code
	,stat
	,Uf_item_header
	,Uf_hierachy_level1
	,Uf_hierachy_level2
	,Uf_hierachy_level3
	,Uf_hierachy_level4
	,cast(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
FROM stg.csi_Item;

merge edw.Dim_Item as tgt
	using 
		(SELECT  Site
			  ,Item
			  ,Description
			  ,ABC_Code
			  ,ProductType
			  ,PMT_Code
			  ,ProductCode
			  ,Stat
			  ,ItemHeader
			  ,ProductCategory
			  ,ProductSubCategory
			  ,ProductFamily
			  ,ProductName
			  ,RecordDate
		  FROM temp_DimItem
		) as src
	on (tgt.Item = src.Item and tgt.Site = src.Site)
when matched then
	update
		set tgt.Description = src.Description,
		tgt.ABC_Code = src.ABC_Code,
		tgt.ProductType = src.ProductType,
		tgt.PMT_Code = src.PMT_Code,
		tgt.ProductCode = src.ProductCode,
		tgt.Stat = src.Stat,
		tgt.ItemHeader = src.ItemHeader,
		tgt.ProductCategory = src.ProductCategory,
		tgt.ProductSubCategory = src.ProductSubCategory,
		tgt.ProductFamily = src.ProductFamily,
		tgt.ProductName = src.ProductName,
		tgt.RecordDate = src.RecordDate
when not matched then
	insert (Site, Item, Description, ABC_Code, ProductType, PMT_Code, ProductCode, Stat, ItemHeader, ProductCategory, ProductSubCategory, ProductFamily, ProductName, RecordDate )
	values (src.Site, src.Item, src.Description, src.ABC_Code, src.ProductType, src.PMT_Code, src.ProductCode, src.Stat, src.ItemHeader, src.ProductCategory, src.ProductSubCategory, src.ProductFamily, src.ProductName, src.RecordDate);
